references.text: God's promise to Abraham to expand Israel's borders, fulfilled when the Lord enlarges the territory mentioned in Deuteronomy.
God's promise to Jacob to expand his descendants' land toward all directions of the sky, linked to the promise of expanding the borders.
The Lord's promise to drive out nations and expand Israel's borders when they come before the Lord's presence.
A parallel text describing the expansion of Israel's borders and God's promise to give them the land they tread upon.
Nearby verses that allow the Israelites to slaughter and eat meat as their heart desires in all their towns.
The continuation of the text elaborating on the permission to eat meat when living far from the sanctuary.
Permission to use the tithe for whatever your soul desires, including meat and wine, linked to the soul's desire.
A reference to when the Lord your God expands your borders, as he promised your fathers.
